name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 14, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84070910557
  Webinar ID: 840 7091 0557
  One-tap Mobile:
  +16469313860,,84070910557# OR +13017158592,,84070910557#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 646 931 3860 OR +1 301 715 8592
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney,

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of December 3, 2025 City Council Special Meeting and December 10, 2025 City
Council Annual Reorganization Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT – COMMUNITY PARK ENTRANCE
  AND RUSSELL RANCH ROAD (COSTCO/MARKET PLACE INTERSECTION) -
  Approve grading the slope entrance at the Community Park with American
  Heritage performing the work.

2.  CULTURAL RECREATION COMMITTEE REPORT – CONEJO RECREATION
  AND PARK DISTRICT SENIOR CLASS FEE REVIEW AND NEW CITY EVENT
  SPONSORSHIP PROGRAM PROPOSAL - Approve a $5 fee increase from $10
  to $15 for senior recreation classes that exceed $80 per class per session and
  approve the expanded City Events Sponsorship Program starting in 2026.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  STATUS UPDATE ON VACANCIES IN COMPLIANCE WITH ASSEMBLY BILL
  2561 (2024) – LOCAL PUBLIC EMPLOYEES; VACANT POSITIONS - City
  Council receive and file this report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective December 1, 2025 in the
  amount of $ 375,227.84; December 15, 2025 in the amount of $1,102148.10; and
  January 1, 2026 in the amount of $823,239.50

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  DEVELOPMENT IMPACT FEES ANNUAL REVIEW - FISCAL YEAR
  2024-25 - City Council receive and file this report.

  2.  AMENDING THE CITY’S PERSONNEL RULES TO REVISE THE CITY’S
  JURY DUTY POLICY; RESOLUTION NO. 2429-26 - Adopt Resolution No.
  2429-26, Amending Section 5.09 of the City’s Personnel Policy to reinstate
  the Personnel Rules language that allows compensation for jury duty for up
  to five days per fiscal year.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2429-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE AMENDING THE CITY’S PERSONNEL RULES TO
  PROVIDE JURY DUTY COMPENSATION FOR UP TO FIVE DAYS PER FISCAL
  YEAR

  3.  ACCEPTANCE OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE CITY COUNCIL
  CHAMBERS AUDIO-VISUAL AND CONTROL SYSTEM UPGRADE
  PROJECT; FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the Council
  Chambers Audio-Visual and Control System Project and authorize the City
  Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for the project on
  behalf of the City.
 OLD BUSINESS:

1.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO WESTERN STATE BUILDERS, INC. FOR
  PLAYGROUND EQUIPMENT AND PLAY AREA SURFACE INSTALLATION
  COMPONENTS OF THE BERNIECE BENNETT PARK REHABILITATION
  PROJECT – Award a construction contract for the installation of playground
  equipment and play area surface for the Berniece Bennett Park Rehabilitation
  Project to Western State Builders in the amount of $256.571.00, determine that
  the project is exempt from CEQA, authorize the City Manager to approve change
  orders up to the 10% contingency amount; and authorize the Mayor to sign and
  execute the construction contract on behalf of the City.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 311-26 AND APPROVAL OF
  PERSONNEL POLICY AMENDMENT TO ESTABLISH JUNETEENTH AS A
  CITY HOLIDAY; RESOLUTION NO. 2430-26 - Waive full reading and introduce
  Ordinance No. 311-26 amending the Westlake Village Municipal Code, approve a
  CEQA exemption, schedule the second reading for January 28, 2026 and adopt
  Resolution No. 2430-26 amending the City’s Personnel Policy to establish
  Juneteenth as a City Holiday.

  ORDINANCE NO. 311-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ESTABLISH
  JUNETEENTH AS A CITY HOLIDAY

  RESOLUTION NO. 2430-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE AMENDING THE CITY’S PERSONNEL RULES TO ESTABLISH
  JUNETEENTH AS A CITY HOLIDAY

2.  APPROVAL OF MISSIONSQUARE CONTRACT AMENDMENT AND 457(B)
  PLAN AMENDMENT; RESOLUTION NO. 2431-26 - Amend the 457(b) Plan
  Administrative Services Agreement with MissionSquare and adopt Resolution No.
  2431-26, authorizing the City Manager to amend the 457(B) Plan to expand
  investment fund options for Plan participants.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2431-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO AMEND THE
  CITY’S 457(B) PLAN TO EXPAND INVESTMENT FUND OPTIONS FOR PLAN
  PARTICIPANTS
 3.  APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE CITY’S CONTRACT WITH
  MISSIONSQUARE TO ESTABLISH A RETIREMENT HEALTH SAVINGS PLAN,
  MONTHLY CONTRIBUTIONS TO PLAN, AMENDMENT TO PERSONNEL
  RULES, DECLARATION OF INTEGRAL PART TRUST TO HOLD PLAN
  ASSETS, AND MISSIONSQUARE ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES AGREEMENT
  FOR PLAN MANAGEMENT; RESOLUTION No. 2432-26 - Adopt Resolution No.
  2432-26 establishing a Retirement Health Savings Plan for regular, full-time
  employees and City councilmembers; approving a Declaration of Integral Part
  Trust to hold assets of the plan, authorizing a $150/month City contribution to such
  plan for eligible employees, amending the Personnel Rules regarding
  disbursement of accrued sick leave upon retirement or separation for regular, full-
  time employees, and authorizing the City Manager to sign an Administrative
  Services Agreement with MissionSquare and other documents necessary or
  appropriate to implement the plan.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2432-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING A RETIREMENT HEALTH SAVINGS PLAN
  (PLAN), APPROVING A DECLARATION OF INTEGRAL PART TRUST TO HOLD THE
  ASSETS OF THE PLAN, AUTHORIZING A MONTHLY CONTRIBUTION TO THE PLAN
  ON BEHALF OF PLAN PARTICIPANTS, AMENDING THE PERSONNEL RULES
  REGARDING DISBURSEMENT OF ACCRUED SICK LEAVE UPON RETIREMENT OR
  SEPARATION FOR REGULAR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES, AND AUTHORIZING
  EXECUTION OF DOCUMENTS AND FORMS FOR PLAN IMPLEMENTATION

4.  2026 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS - Approve the 2026 City
  Council Committee Assignments as submitted by Mayor McSweeney.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, January 8, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  January 8, 2026
